whatThisPluginAdds.text: Theme Liquid Glass adds translucent layers, depth, refraction grids, and floating navigation to Capell page presentation. Capell and Layout Builder retain ownership of the page data.

surfaceOutcome.text: When selected, Layout Builder pages render with the theme's glass-layered visual system while preserving the existing content structure.

developers.text: Typed widget keys and a layout-native provider connect bespoke presentation to the shared Layout Builder container pipeline.

teams.text: Design teams can apply a consistent glass treatment across hero, grid, and navigation sections without relocating content into theme-specific storage.
